xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Deputy Commissioner of State Tax, MUM‑NOD‑E‑0106, Nodal‑1, Department of Goods & Services Tax, Government of Maharashtra
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Order in Form GST DRC‑07 for FY 2021‑22 determining tax, interest and penalty under section 73 read with section 50 and section 122 of the MGST Act, 2017, and corresponding provisions of CGST/IGST Acts, in respect of scrutiny of GST returns of F D C Limited. ​
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Alleged excess availment of input tax credit not confirmed in GSTR‑2A/2B, ineligible ITC from a cancelled supplier, and interest and penalty on such amounts under section 73 and section 50 of the MGST/CGST Acts for the period 1 April 2021 to 31 March 2022. ​
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The order determines total dues of Rs. 34,10,210 comprising tax of Rs. 3,72,105, interest of Rs. 3,000,894 and penalty of Rs. 37,211 (IGST Rs. 8,87,269; CGST Rs. 12,61,470; SGST Rs. 12,61,470), which will be recognised as an expense/liability in the financial statements; the order is appealable and is not expected to have a material adverse impact on the company’s ongoing operations. ​
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Office of the Superintendent, Central Goods & Services Tax, Range-I, Division-II, Dera Bassi, Punjab
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Order-in-Original passed under Section 73 of the CGST Act, 2017 confirming demand towards alleged wrongful availment of Input Tax Credit (ITC) for FY 2021-22
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Alleged non-compliance with provisions of Section 18(3) read with Rule 41 of the CGST Rules, 2017 and Applicable under Section 50 of the CGST Act relating to transfer of ITC pursuant to business transfer, and mismatch between ITC availed in GSTR-3B and reflected in GSTR-2A
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: Demand of ITC amounting to ₹18,58,476 along with applicable interest under Section 50 of the CGST Act and penalty of ₹1,95,070 imposed under Section 73(9) of the CGST Act. The Company is perusing the order and will seek appropriate legal remedy in order to contest the demand. The Company does not foresee any material financial impact on account of the order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Deputy Commissioner of State Tax, MUM‑NOD‑E‑0106, Nodal‑1, Department of Goods & Services Tax, Government of Maharashtra
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Order in Form GST DRC‑07 for FY 2021‑22 determining tax, interest and penalty under section 73 read with section 50 and section 122 of the MGST Act, 2017, and corresponding provisions of CGST/IGST Acts, in respect of scrutiny of GST returns of F D C Limited. ​
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Misclassification of tax rate: charged 18% GST instead of applicable 28% (CGST 14% + SGST 14% + Compensation Cess 12%).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: Total demand of ₹15,61,40,301, including differential tax ₹8,42,27,725 interest ₹6,34,89,803, and penalty ₹84,22,773 u/s 73 (9) of CGST/MGST Act 2017 r.w. 50 (3) of CGST/MGST Act. The Company is perusing the order and will seek appropriate legal remedy in order to contest the demand. The Company does not foresee any material financial impact on account of the order.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheAuthority: Office of the Superintendent, UPPAL-I Range, UPPAL, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, CBIC, Telangana
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: Order passed under Section 73 of the CGST Act, 2017 pursuant to SCN issued for FY 2021-22. Demand confirmed vide Order-in-Original No. 15/2025-26 and summarized through FORM GST DRC-07. The order confirms tax and penalty liability.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Alleged short payment / non-payment of GST for the period April 2021 to March 2022, as detailed in OIO No. 15/2025-26, based on departmental verification and records.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: Total demand: ₹20,42,592 comprising CGST ₹9,19,844, SGST ₹9,19,844 and penalty ₹2,02,904 u/s 73 of CGST/TSGST Act 2017 r.w. 50 (3) of CGST/TSGST & Section 122(2)(a) of the CGST, 2017 Act. The Company is perusing the order and will seek appropriate legal remedy in order to contest the demand. The Company does not foresee any material financial impact on account of the order.
